beforeCriteria.F01-AC1: **(US-001) Given** an active account with a correct User ID and password, **when** the user signs in, **then** they reach their role's home screen and see data from that account's madrasa only.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC2: **(US-001) Given** an account with a registered email, **when** someone types that email into the User ID field, **then** sign-in fails with the same message as a wrong password.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC3: **(US-001) Given** a wrong password, or a User ID that does not exist, **when** sign-in is attempted, **then** the same message is shown in both cases ("User ID or password is incorrect").
beforeCriteria.F01-AC4: **(US-001) Given** a User ID that has reached the failed-attempt limit, **when** another attempt is made, **then** it is refused for the cooling period, and the refusal looks the same whether or not the User ID exists.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC5: **(US-001) Given** a signed-in user, **when** they sign out, **then** their refresh token is revoked, and any later request using that session's tokens is rejected.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC6: **(US-001) Given** a session that has expired, **when** the app calls the API, **then** the app shows the session-expired sign-in prompt, and unsynced local changes are kept.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC7: **(US-002) Given** an account with a registered email, **when** the user requests a reset by entering their User ID, **then** an OTP is emailed to that account's email only, and the screen shows a neutral confirmation.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC8: **(US-002) Given** a User ID that does not exist, or an account with no email, **when** a reset is requested, **then** the same neutral confirmation is shown and no email is sent.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC9: **(US-002) Given** an OTP that has expired, or has had too many wrong tries, **when** it is submitted, **then** it is rejected and the password is unchanged.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC10: **(US-002) Given** a valid OTP, **when** the user sets a new password that meets the policy, **then** the password changes and every existing session of that account is revoked. An audit event is recorded that contains neither the OTP nor the password.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC11: **(US-002) Given** an account that has hit the OTP request limit, **when** another OTP is requested, **then** no new OTP is sent until the limit window passes.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC12: **(US-003) Given** a Madrasa Admin, **when** they create a Teacher, Student, or Parent account with a User ID, **then** the account exists in that madrasa with that role, and an audit event is recorded.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC13: **(US-003) Given** a Teacher, Student, or Parent, **when** they call the create-account endpoint, **then** it returns forbidden and nothing is created.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC14: **(US-003) Given** a User ID that is already in use, **when** the Admin creates another account with the same ID, **then** creation is rejected with "User ID already in use".
beforeCriteria.F01-AC15: **(US-004) Given** an Admin-set initial password, **when** the account is saved, **then** only a password hash is stored, and the plain password does not appear in the database, logs, or audit records.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC16: **(US-004) Given** an initial password that does not meet the password policy, **when** the Admin saves, **then** the password field shows an error and the account is not created.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC17: **(US-004) Given** a new account, **when** the user signs in for the first time with the Admin-set password, **then** they go straight to their home screen and are not asked to change the password.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC18: **(US-005) Given** a Student account with email `x@example.com`, **when** the Admin creates a Parent account with the same email, **then** the Parent account is saved.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC19: **(US-005) Given** a Student and a Parent who share an email, **when** the Parent resets their password using the Parent User ID, **then** the Student's password and sessions are unchanged.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC20: **(US-006) Given** a person with accounts in Madrasa A and Madrasa B, **when** they are signed in to the A account and request a Madrasa B record by its ID, **then** the response is "not found", exactly as for an ID that does not exist.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC21: **(US-006) Given** a person whose Madrasa A account has been deactivated, **when** they sign in to their Madrasa B account, **then** sign-in works normally.
beforeCriteria.F01-AC22: **(US-006) Given** a deactivated account, **when** it tries to sign in or use an existing session, **then** it is refused and its sessions are revoked.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC1: **(US-007) Given** a newly created madrasa, **when** its settings are first opened, **then** the timezone is `Asia/Karachi`, the week starts on Monday, and the daily-report mode is "one report per student/date".
beforeCriteria.F02-AC2: **(US-007) Given** an Owner or Admin, **when** they save a changed name, timezone, or week start, **then** the change is saved, audited, and used by reports generated afterwards.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC3: **(US-007) Given** an empty workspace name, **when** the Admin saves, **then** the name field shows an error and nothing is saved.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC4: **(US-007) Given** a Teacher, Student, or Parent, **when** they open workspace settings or call the update endpoint, **then** they see no edit controls and the API returns forbidden.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC5: **(US-007) Given** existing daily records, **when** the Admin changes the timezone, **then** the stored `report_date` of every existing record is unchanged.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC6: **(US-008) Given** a Teacher assigned only to Class A, **when** they open the student list, **then** only students enrolled in Class A are listed.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC7: **(US-008) Given** the same Teacher, **when** they request a Class B student, record, or report by ID, **then** the response is "not found", exactly as for an ID that does not exist.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC8: **(US-008) Given** a Teacher removed from Class A, **when** they next sync or make a request, **then** no Class A data is returned. Records they created earlier remain, with them still shown as the recorder.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC9: **(US-008) Given** a request whose body contains an `organization_id`, a role, or a class the user is not assigned to, **when** the server processes it, **then** those values are ignored or rejected. Scope always comes from the signed-in membership.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC10: **(US-009) Given** any of these actions: account create/deactivate, role or membership change, password reset, guardian link change, note-visibility change, **when** it succeeds, **then** exactly one audit record is written with the actor, action, target, timestamp, and a safe summary.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC11: **(US-009) Given** a password reset or account creation, **when** its audit record is read, **then** it contains no password, OTP, or token.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC12: **(US-009) Given** any role, including Owner, **when** they try to edit or delete an audit record through the app or API, **then** no such operation exists or it is rejected.
beforeCriteria.F02-AC13: **(US-009) Given** a sensitive change whose audit write fails, **when** the transaction ends, **then** the change itself is rolled back too.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC1: **(US-010) Given** an Admin, **when** they create a class with a name and assign one or more Teachers, **then** the class appears in the class list, and each assigned Teacher can see it.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC2: **(US-010) Given** an empty class name, **when** the Admin saves, **then** the name field shows an error and nothing is saved.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC3: **(US-010) Given** a Teacher, **when** they try to create, edit, or deactivate a class, **then** there is no control for it, and the API returns forbidden.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC4: **(US-010) Given** a class with past attendance and daily records, **when** the Admin deactivates it, **then** it disappears from the class pickers in Daily Entry and Bulk Entry. Its past records and reports remain viewable.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC5: **(US-010) Given** a madrasa with no classes, **when** the Admin opens Classes, **then** the empty state "No classes yet" and an "Add class" action are shown.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC6: **(US-011) Given** an Admin, **when** they create a student with a name (plus an optional External Student ID and admission date), **then** the student is saved in the active madrasa and the creation is audited.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC7: **(US-011) Given** an External Student ID that is already used by another student in the same madrasa, **when** the Admin saves, **then** the save is rejected with a field error.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC8: **(US-011) Given** a list of more than one page of students, **when** the user searches by name or External Student ID, or filters by class or status, **then** only matching students are shown, page by page.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC9: **(US-011) Given** a student with daily records, attempts, homework, and reports, **when** the Admin deactivates the student, **then** none of those records are deleted. The student leaves the entry pickers but stays in reports for earlier periods.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC10: **(US-011) Given** a deactivated student, **when** the Admin reactivates them, **then** they appear again in the entry pickers with all of their history intact.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC11: **(US-012) Given** a student enrolled in Class A, **when** the Admin moves them to Class B from a given date, **then** the Class A enrollment ends the day before and the Class B enrollment starts on that date.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC12: **(US-012) Given** a student moved from Class A to Class B, **when** a report for an earlier period is viewed, **then** records from before the move still show Class A.
beforeCriteria.F03-AC13: **(US-012) Given** a student's profile, **when** the Details tab is opened, **then** the full enrollment history is listed with start and end dates.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC1: **(US-013) Given** a class scheduled Monday to Saturday, **when** the weekly report for a week is built, **then** the scheduled class days are that week's Monday to Saturday, and Sunday is a no-class day.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC2: **(US-013) Given** a schedule changed from a given effective date, **when** reports are built, **then** days before that date use the old schedule and days from that date use the new one.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC3: **(US-014) Given** a holiday declared for the whole madrasa on a date, **when** that date is reported, **then** it shows as a holiday, and no student is counted absent for it.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC4: **(US-014) Given** a no-class exception for one class on a date, **when** that date is reported, **then** only that class's students show "no class" for it.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC5: **(US-014) Given** a date that is a holiday, **when** a Teacher opens Bulk Entry for that date, **then** the screen says it is a holiday and that no absence is recorded automatically.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC6: **(US-015) Given** a class with enrolled students, **when** the Teacher opens Bulk Entry for a date, **then** each student has only a Present/Absent control. There are no Sabaq, Sabqi, Manzil, mistake, quality, or excused fields.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC7: **(US-015) Given** a Teacher using "Mark all Present", **when** some students already have attendance recorded for that date, **then** those students keep their existing mark.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC8: **(US-015) Given** a student the Teacher left unmarked, **when** Bulk Entry is saved, **then** that student is "not marked". They are not counted as absent.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC9: **(US-015) Given** one row that fails validation, **when** Bulk Entry is saved, **then** the valid rows are saved and the failed row shows its error. The result summary counts saved, needs-correction, and not-marked rows.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC10: **(US-015) Given** a Bulk Entry save that was already sent, **when** it is retried after a network failure, **then** no duplicate attendance records are created.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC11: **(US-015) Given** a student marked Absent, **when** the save completes, **then** no portion attempt, failed recitation, or quality value is created for that student.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC12: **(US-015) Given** no internet connection, **when** the Teacher saves Bulk Entry, **then** the screen says "Saved on this device — waiting to sync", and the records are queued.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC13: **(US-016) Given** a student marked Absent in their individual Daily Entry, **when** the Teacher chooses "Mark as excused" and adds an optional reason, **then** the record shows "Excused — awaiting approval".
beforeCriteria.F04-AC14: **(US-016) Given** a student marked Present, **when** the Teacher views attendance, **then** no "Mark as excused" option is offered.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC15: **(US-017) Given** an excused absence awaiting a decision, **when** the Admin approves it, **then** it counts as an excused absence in reports, and the decision is audited with the Admin and the time.
beforeCriteria.F04-AC16: **(US-017) Given** an excused absence awaiting a decision, **when** the Admin rejects it, **then** it counts as a normal absence, and the Teacher's record shows "Excuse rejected".
beforeCriteria.F04-AC17: **(US-017) Given** a Teacher, **when** they try to approve or reject an excused absence, **then** there is no control for it, and the API returns forbidden.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC1: **(US-018) Given** a Teacher with an assigned student, **when** they choose a date, a class, and the student and save portions, **then** a daily record is stored with the date the Teacher chose as `report_date`. That date is kept separate from the save time and the sync time.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC2: **(US-018) Given** a daily record that was saved offline and synced the next day, **when** it is viewed, **then** its `report_date` is still the date the Teacher chose.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC3: **(US-018) Given** a portion with a missing required field, **when** the Teacher saves, **then** the error names the section, the portion number, and the field (e.g. "Sabqi · Portion 2: unit is required"), and all entered values are kept.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC4: **(US-018) Given** a saved daily record, **when** the Teacher edits a portion, **then** the edit is audited, draft homework and reports recalculate, and confirmed homework is unchanged. The notice "Confirmed homework was not changed" is shown.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC5: **(US-018) Given** a student marked Absent, **when** the record is saved, **then** no portion is treated as failed, and no quality is recorded for that day.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC6: **(US-019) Given** a madrasa in one-report-per-student/date mode, **when** a Teacher starts a second record for the same student and date, **then** the app warns and opens the existing record. No duplicate is created.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC7: **(US-019) Given** a madrasa in multiple-session mode, **when** a Teacher creates a record, **then** a session label is required, and two records for the same student and date are allowed if their labels differ.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC8: **(US-019) Given** multiple-session mode with some student/date having two sessions, **when** the Admin tries to switch to one-report mode, **then** the switch is blocked, with a message listing the conflicts.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC9: **(US-019) Given** a Teacher, **when** they try to change the daily-report mode, **then** there is no control for it, and the API returns forbidden.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC10: **(US-020) Given** a Sabaq portion, **when** the Teacher saves it, **then** it stores the Para number, an optional Surah and Ayat range, the assigned and completed quantity with its unit, the status, mistakes, quality, and remarks.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC11: **(US-021) Given** Sabqi portions for Para 3 and Para 4, **when** Para 3 is marked Completed and Para 4 Partial, **then** each keeps its own status, and changing one never changes the other.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC12: **(US-021) Given** a current Sabaq in Para 5, **when** the Teacher adds a Sabqi portion, **then** Para 5 may be offered as the default, but the Teacher can choose any other Para or several Paras.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC13: **(US-022) Given** Manzil portions for Para 1, Para 5, and Para 10, **when** they are marked Completed, Partial at 1/2, and Not Remembered, **then** the record and its report show all three outcomes separately, never collapsed into one status (AC-QTY-06).
beforeCriteria.F05-AC14: **(US-022) Given** a portion marked Not Remembered, **when** it is saved without a completed quantity, **then** the completed quantity is 0 and the remaining quantity equals the assigned quantity. The Teacher can correct this.
beforeCriteria.F05-AC15: **(US-023) Given** a portion with one attempt, **when** the Teacher adds a second attempt, **then** both attempts are stored with their own time, recorder, completed quantity, status, mistakes, and quality, and the first attempt is unchanged (AC-ATT-05).
beforeCriteria.F05-AC16: **(US-023) Given** a portion with two attempts, **when** progress and reports are calculated, **then** the latest attempt gives the current status, the assigned quantity is counted once, and both attempts appear in the history.
beforeCriteria.F06-AC1: **(US-024) Given** a Madrasa Admin, **when** they add or edit a Surah (number, Arabic name, Ayat count) or a Para boundary, **then** it is saved for their madrasa and the change is audited.
beforeCriteria.F06-AC2: **(US-024) Given** a Teacher, **when** they try to edit Quran metadata, **then** there is no edit control, and the API returns forbidden.
beforeCriteria.F06-AC3: **(US-024) Given** a Surah's Arabic name, **when** it is saved and shown in English, Urdu, or Roman Urdu, **then** the Arabic text is exactly what was entered and is never translated or transliterated.
beforeCriteria.F06-AC4: **(US-024) Given** a Para boundary whose end comes before its start, **when** the Admin saves, **then** it is rejected with a field error.
beforeCriteria.F06-AC5: **(US-025) Given** a Para between 1 and 30, **when** the Teacher saves a portion, **then** it is accepted. Para 0 or Para 31 is rejected.
beforeCriteria.F06-AC6: **(US-025) Given** a Surah with 7 Ayat, **when** the Teacher enters Ayat 3 to 9 for it, **then** the field shows an error that names the maximum Ayat.
beforeCriteria.F06-AC7: **(US-025) Given** a range whose end Ayat is before its start Ayat in the same Surah, **when** the Teacher saves, **then** the range field shows an error.
beforeCriteria.F06-AC8: **(US-026) Given** a portion measured in lines, **when** it is saved, **then** the unit is `LINES` with a whole number, counted on the standard 15-line Mushaf.
beforeCriteria.F06-AC9: **(US-026) Given** 10 lines assigned and 6 lines completed, **when** the remaining quantity is calculated, **then** it is 4 lines (AC-QTY-02).
beforeCriteria.F06-AC10: **(US-027) Given** a Teacher choosing Salasah, **when** the portion is saved, **then** it is stored as 3/4 Para and displayed as "Salasah (3/4 Para)" (AC-QTY-01).
beforeCriteria.F06-AC11: **(US-027) Given** Rubu, Half, or Complete, **when** saved, **then** each is stored exactly as 1/4, 1/2, or 1 Para.
beforeCriteria.F06-AC12: **(US-027) Given** 3/4 Para assigned and 1/2 Para completed for the same portion, **when** the remaining quantity is calculated, **then** it is 1/4 Para (AC-QTY-03).
beforeCriteria.F06-AC13: **(US-027) Given** one portion in lines and another in Para fractions, **when** a total is requested, **then** they are shown as two separate totals and never added together (AC-QTY-04).
beforeCriteria.F06-AC14: **(US-027) Given** a completed quantity larger than the assigned quantity, **when** the Teacher saves, **then** the completed field shows an error (AC-QTY-05).
beforeCriteria.F06-AC15: **(US-027) Given** a Teacher who changes the unit after typing a value, **when** the unit changes, **then** the app asks whether to keep or clear the value and never silently reinterprets the number.
beforeCriteria.F07-AC1: **(US-028) Given** a portion attempt, **when** the Teacher adds two mistakes (Tajweed and Lafzi), **then** both are stored on that attempt, each with exactly one category.
beforeCriteria.F07-AC2: **(US-028) Given** a mistake saved in the Urdu interface, **when** it is viewed in English, **then** the category shows its English label, and the stored value is the same canonical value (`TAJWEED`).
beforeCriteria.F07-AC3: **(US-028) Given** mistakes recorded during a week, **when** the weekly report is built, **then** it shows a count per category for that week.
beforeCriteria.F07-AC4: **(US-029) Given** a mistake, **when** the Teacher sets Major, **then** it is stored and shown as Major. The API rejects any severity other than Minor or Major.
beforeCriteria.F07-AC5: **(US-030) Given** a mistake, **when** the Teacher turns on Repeated, **then** its severity is unchanged, and Repeated is stored as its own flag.
beforeCriteria.F07-AC6: **(US-031) Given** the quality selector, **when** it opens, **then** it lists "1 · Excellent", "2 · Good", "3 · Average", "4 · Needs Improvement", and "5 · Weak" in that order, in the active language, with "Not assessed" selected.
beforeCriteria.F07-AC7: **(US-031) Given** a portion saved without a quality score, **when** it is shown, **then** it reads "Not recorded" (never 0), and the stored value is NULL.
beforeCriteria.F07-AC8: **(US-031) Given** quality scores 1, 2, 2 and one missing, **when** the average is calculated, **then** it is 1.7 from 3 ratings, shown as "1.7 · Good (3 ratings)".
beforeCriteria.F07-AC9: **(US-031) Given** an average of exactly 1.5, **when** it is labelled, **then** the label is "Good" (a halfway value rounds up to the higher number).
beforeCriteria.F07-AC10: **(US-031) Given** an attempt with status Absent, Not Assigned, or Pending, **when** the Teacher views it, **then** no quality score can be entered, and none is counted.
beforeCriteria.F07-AC11: **(US-031) Given** any AI feature or automated process, **when** it runs, **then** it never sets or changes a quality score; only the Teacher's input writes it.
beforeCriteria.F07-AC12: **(US-032) Given** a daily record, **when** the Teacher picks an overall performance label, **then** it is stored once for the record, separately from every portion's quality score.
beforeCriteria.F07-AC13: **(US-032) Given** portions with quality scores, **when** the daily record is saved without an overall label, **then** the label stays empty; it is never filled in from the scores, and the scores are never filled in from the label.
beforeCriteria.F08-AC1: **(US-033) Given** a Teacher creating homework, **when** they add one Sabaq portion and two Sabqi Paras with different quantities, **then** each portion is stored with its section, Para, optional range, quantity and unit, and optional instructions.
beforeCriteria.F08-AC2: **(US-033) Given** a homework assignment, **when** it is saved, **then** it stores the assigned date, the due date, the status, the creator, and any general instructions.
beforeCriteria.F08-AC3: **(US-034) Given** 3/4 Para assigned and 1/2 Para completed for the same portion, **when** the remaining quantity is calculated, **then** it is 1/4 Para.
beforeCriteria.F08-AC4: **(US-034) Given** the assigned and completed quantities are in different units, **when** remaining is calculated, **then** no remaining quantity is shown, and the portion is flagged for the Teacher to review.
beforeCriteria.F08-AC5: **(US-035) Given** a portion whose latest attempt is Partial or Not Remembered with remaining > 0, **when** suggestions are built, **then** it is suggested with its remaining quantity and linked to its source attempt (AC-HW-01, AC-HW-08).
beforeCriteria.F08-AC6: **(US-035) Given** a portion whose latest attempt is Absent, Not Assigned, Pending, or Completed, **when** suggestions are built, **then** it is not suggested (AC-HW-09).
beforeCriteria.F08-AC7: **(US-035) Given** a suggestion, **when** it is displayed, **then** it is labelled "Suggestion — not confirmed" and never styled like confirmed homework.
beforeCriteria.F08-AC8: **(US-036) Given** a draft suggestion, **when** the Teacher edits a quantity, removes a portion, adds a new portion, or changes the due date, **then** the draft keeps those changes, and each portion records whether it was suggested, edited, or added by the Teacher (AC-HW-02).
beforeCriteria.F08-AC9: **(US-036) Given** a draft suggestion, **when** the Teacher rejects it, **then** its status becomes Rejected, and it is not counted as homework.
beforeCriteria.F08-AC10: **(US-037) Given** a draft, **when** the Teacher presses Confirm and accepts the summary, **then** the status becomes Confirmed with the confirming Teacher and the time, and the confirmation is audited (AC-HW-04).
beforeCriteria.F08-AC11: **(US-037) Given** no Teacher action, **when** time passes or the next class arrives, **then** the draft is never confirmed automatically (AC-HW-03).
beforeCriteria.F08-AC12: **(US-037) Given** a confirmation where one portion fails to save, **when** the transaction ends, **then** nothing is confirmed, and no partial assignment is left behind.
beforeCriteria.F08-AC13: **(US-038) Given** a confirmed assignment, **when** the Teacher creates a new assignment for the next class, **then** the earlier assignment is kept unchanged (AC-HW-05).
beforeCriteria.F08-AC14: **(US-038) Given** a source attempt is corrected, **when** recalculation runs, **then** draft suggestions are rebuilt, and confirmed assignments are unchanged (AC-HW-06, AC-HW-07). The Teacher sees "Confirmed homework was not changed — Revise?".
beforeCriteria.F08-AC15: **(US-038) Given** a Teacher who chooses Revise on confirmed homework, **when** they confirm the revision, **then** a new assignment is created with a link to the old one, the old one becomes Superseded, and both are audited.
beforeCriteria.F08-AC16: **(US-038) Given** the next class, **when** the Teacher records an attempt on a homework portion, **then** the attempt links to that homework portion (FR-HW-015).
beforeCriteria.F09-AC1: **(US-039) Given** the organization timezone `Asia/Karachi` and a Monday week start, **when** a weekly report is opened for a date, **then** it covers Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 of that week in `Asia/Karachi`, and states the date range (AC-RPT-07).
beforeCriteria.F09-AC2: **(US-039) Given** a week of source records, **when** the weekly report is built, **then** every total equals a calculation made directly from the source records (AC-RPT-01).
beforeCriteria.F09-AC3: **(US-039) Given** a weekly report already viewed, **when** a daily record in that week is corrected, **then** the next view of the report shows the corrected totals (AC-RPT-02).
beforeCriteria.F09-AC4: **(US-039) Given** quantities in lines and Para fractions in the same week, **when** totals are shown, **then** they are grouped by unit and never combined (AC-RPT-04).
beforeCriteria.F09-AC5: **(US-039) Given** a portion with two attempts, **when** the report counts assigned work, **then** the portion's assigned quantity is counted once, and its current status comes from the latest attempt (AC-RPT-05).
beforeCriteria.F09-AC6: **(US-039) Given** confirmed and draft homework in the week, **when** the report lists homework, **then** confirmed homework and draft suggestions appear as separate counts (AC-RPT-06).
beforeCriteria.F09-AC7: **(US-039) Given** quality scores 1, 3 and two missing, **when** average quality is shown, **then** it reads "2.0 · Good (2 ratings)". The missing ratings are not counted as zero (AC-RPT-03).
beforeCriteria.F09-AC8: **(US-040) Given** a month of records, **when** the monthly report is built, **then** Sabaq, Sabqi, and Manzil are aggregated separately, with Para-wise progress and pending portions.
beforeCriteria.F09-AC9: **(US-040) Given** a month of homework, **when** the monthly report is built, **then** assigned, attempted, completed, and carried-forward homework are shown as four separate measures.
beforeCriteria.F09-AC10: **(US-040) Given** a Para with Major or repeated mistakes in several attempts that month, **when** the report is built, **then** that Para is listed as a recurring difficulty, with its mistake counts by category.
beforeCriteria.F09-AC11: **(US-041) Given** a student who was absent two days and recited on four, **when** the report is shown, **then** the attendance section shows 2 absences, and the performance section shows only the four recited days, with no failed or zero entries for the absent days.
beforeCriteria.F09-AC12: **(US-041) Given** a holiday and a Sunday with no scheduled class, **when** attendance is shown, **then** they are listed as holiday and no-class days, not as absences (AC-RPT-08).
beforeCriteria.F09-AC13: **(US-042) Given** one Admin-approved excused absence, one rejected excuse, and one plain absence, **when** the report is shown, **then** it shows 1 excused absence and 2 normal absences.
beforeCriteria.F09-AC14: **(US-043) Given** Manzil Para 1 Completed, Para 5 Partial (1/2), and Para 10 Not Remembered on one day, **when** the daily detail is shown, **then** all three appear as separate lines with their own status and quantity.
beforeCriteria.F09-AC15: **(US-039) Given** a viewer without permission for internal notes, **when** the report is shown, **then** internal notes are absent from the response payload, not just hidden in the UI.
beforeCriteria.F09-AC16: **(US-039) Given** a Teacher offline with unsynced changes, **when** they open a report, **then** it is labelled "Provisional", with the last successful sync time and the number of pending changes.
beforeCriteria.F10-AC1: **(US-044) Given** a signed-in Student, **when** they open Reports, **then** they see only their own published reports, and there are no edit controls anywhere.
beforeCriteria.F10-AC2: **(US-044) Given** a signed-in Student, **when** they request another student's report by changing an ID, **then** the response is "not found".
beforeCriteria.F10-AC3: **(US-044) Given** a report period that has not been published, **when** the Student opens Reports, **then** that period is not listed, and its data is not in any response.
beforeCriteria.F10-AC4: **(US-044) Given** a Student with no internet connection, **when** they open the app, **then** a "network unavailable" state is shown, with no cached report data.
beforeCriteria.F10-AC5: **(US-045) Given** a Parent verified-linked to two children, **when** they open the app, **then** they can switch between those two children only.
beforeCriteria.F10-AC6: **(US-045) Given** a Parent who knows another student's name, phone, or email, **when** they look for that student, **then** there is no search, and API requests for that student return "not found".
beforeCriteria.F10-AC7: **(US-045) Given** a Parent whose link to a child is revoked, **when** they next request that child's data, **then** the request is refused, and the child disappears from their switcher.
beforeCriteria.F10-AC8: **(US-045) Given** an Admin linking, verifying, or revoking a Parent, **when** the action succeeds, **then** it is audited.
beforeCriteria.F10-AC9: **(US-046) Given** a Teacher writing a note, **when** they don't change visibility, **then** the note is "Private to staff" by default.
beforeCriteria.F10-AC10: **(US-046) Given** a note set to "Private to staff", **when** a Student or Parent view, API response, PDF, Excel export, or push notification is produced, **then** the note's text is not present in it.
beforeCriteria.F10-AC11: **(US-046) Given** a note set to "Visible to student/guardian", **when** the Student or a linked Parent views the report, **then** the note is shown.
beforeCriteria.F10-AC12: **(US-046) Given** a Teacher who changes a note's visibility, **when** it is saved, **then** the change is audited.
beforeCriteria.F11-AC1: **(US-047) Given** English selected, **when** any screen is shown, **then** navigation, labels, buttons, validation messages, and empty states are in English, and the layout is left to right (AC-I18N-01).
beforeCriteria.F11-AC2: **(US-048) Given** Urdu selected, **when** any screen is shown, **then** all of the same text is in Urdu script, and the layout is right to left (AC-I18N-02).
beforeCriteria.F11-AC3: **(US-049) Given** Roman Urdu selected, **when** any screen is shown, **then** all key strings are in Roman Urdu, and the layout is left to right (AC-I18N-03).
beforeCriteria.F11-AC4: **(US-047) Given** a user who chose Urdu, **when** they sign out and sign in again, on this device or another, **then** the app opens in Urdu (AC-I18N-04).
beforeCriteria.F11-AC5: **(US-048) Given** a half-filled Daily Entry form, **when** the user switches from English to Urdu, **then** every entered value is still there, and no app restart is needed (AC-I18N-05).
beforeCriteria.F11-AC6: **(US-048) Given** a portion saved as Not Remembered in Urdu, **when** it is read from the database, **then** the stored status is `NOT_REMEMBERED`, the same value as when it is saved in English.
beforeCriteria.F11-AC7: **(US-049) Given** the Roman Urdu glossary, **when** a domain term (Sabaq, Sabqi, Manzil, Para, Rubu, Salasah) appears on screen, **then** it uses the glossary spelling everywhere.
beforeCriteria.F11-AC8: **(US-050) Given** a Surah name stored in Arabic, **when** it is shown in English, Urdu, or Roman Urdu, **then** the Arabic characters are identical to the stored value and are not translated or transliterated.
beforeCriteria.F11-AC9: **(US-050) Given** the range "البقرة 2:255–260" inside an English sentence and inside an Urdu sentence, **when** it is rendered, **then** the numbers and the Arabic both read correctly in both directions (AC-I18N-06).
beforeCriteria.F11-AC10: **(US-050) Given** Arabic text exported to PDF or Excel, **when** the file is opened, **then** the Arabic text is unchanged.
beforeCriteria.F11-AC11: **(US-047) Given** every message key in the app and server catalogues, **when** CI runs, **then** each key exists in `en`, `ur`, and `ur-Latn`, or the build fails.
beforeCriteria.F11-AC12: **(US-047) Given** Android's largest font size, **when** the main screens are shown, **then** text is not clipped, and touch targets stay at least 44 dp.
beforeCriteria.F11-AC13: **(US-047) Given** a status shown anywhere, **when** it is rendered, **then** it has a text label and an icon, never color alone.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC1: **(US-051) Given** no internet connection, **when** the Teacher saves a daily record, **then** the record and its outbox operation are written in one local transaction before the screen says "Saved on this device — waiting to sync".
beforeCriteria.F12-AC2: **(US-051) Given** a saved offline change, **when** the app is force-closed and reopened, **then** the change and its pending operation are still there.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC3: **(US-051) Given** a new record created offline, **when** it is saved, **then** it has a client-generated UUID that never changes, including after sync.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC4: **(US-052) Given** pending operations, **when** the connection returns, **then** they are sent in order, and a record is sent before the portions and attempts that depend on it.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC5: **(US-052) Given** an operation the server already applied, **when** the app sends it again because the acknowledgement was lost, **then** the server returns the stored result, and no duplicate record, attempt, attendance, or homework portion is created.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC6: **(US-052) Given** a temporary server error, **when** sync fails, **then** it retries with increasing delays, and the operation stays pending.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC7: **(US-052) Given** changes made by others on the server, **when** the app pulls with its last cursor, **then** it receives only changes since that cursor, filtered to what the Teacher is allowed to see.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC8: **(US-053) Given** pending operations, **when** the Teacher opens the sync queue, **then** each item shows one of: pending, syncing, synced, failed (with a reason and Retry), or action required.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC9: **(US-053) Given** a change saved locally, **when** the server has not yet acknowledged it, **then** the UI never shows it as synced.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC10: **(US-053) Given** unsynced changes, **when** the Teacher tries to sign out, **then** a warning shows the count, with the options "Sync now", "Cancel", and "Sign out anyway".
beforeCriteria.F12-AC11: **(US-054) Given** a portion's status edited on two devices from the same base version, **when** the second edit syncs, **then** a conflict is created holding both versions, and the record is marked action required. Neither version is applied over the other.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC12: **(US-054) Given** a conflict, **when** an authorized user picks a version or merges fields in Conflict Review, **then** the result is applied as a new audited change, and the conflict is closed.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC13: **(US-054) Given** a field that is not meaningful (such as display order) changed on both devices, **when** they sync, **then** the documented safe merge applies with no conflict.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC14: **(US-052) Given** a Teacher whose access was revoked, **when** the app syncs, **then** the server refuses with "access revoked", and the app stops syncing that workspace and locks its cached data. Pending changes stay visible.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC15: **(US-052) Given** an app version older than the supported sync protocol, **when** it syncs, **then** the server answers "upgrade required", and pending changes are kept.
beforeCriteria.F12-AC16: **(US-051) Given** a local database upgrade in a new app version, **when** it runs with pending operations, **then** every pending operation survives and still syncs.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC1: **(US-055) Given** a weekly or monthly report, **when** the user taps PDF, **then** a PDF is produced with the report type, date range, timezone, Sabaq/Sabqi/Manzil details, quantities with units, statuses, and authorized remarks.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC2: **(US-055) Given** a report generated in Urdu, **when** the PDF opens, **then** the layout is right to left, and the Urdu text is shaped correctly (no disconnected letters).
beforeCriteria.F13-AC3: **(US-055) Given** a report containing a Surah name in Arabic, **when** the PDF opens, **then** the Arabic is identical to the stored text and uses the Quranic font.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC4: **(US-055) Given** quality scores in the report, **when** the PDF opens, **then** each score is shown as number + label from the approved scale in the report's language.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC5: **(US-055) Given** a report that spans several pages, **when** it is rendered, **then** table headers repeat on each page, and no row is split across a page break.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC6: **(US-056) Given** a Madrasa Admin, **when** they upload a logo and set colors and headings, **then** every PDF generated afterwards for that madrasa uses them.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC7: **(US-056) Given** a Teacher, **when** they open report template settings, **then** there are no edit controls, and the API returns forbidden.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC8: **(US-056) Given** any template customization, **when** a PDF is generated, **then** the report's numbers and content are identical to the default template's; only the presentation differs.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC9: **(US-056) Given** a logo file that is too large or not an image, **when** the Admin uploads it, **then** it is rejected with a field error.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC10: **(US-057) Given** a Parent requesting a PDF, **when** it is generated, **then** it contains only their verified linked child's published data, with no internal notes.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC11: **(US-057) Given** a Teacher requesting a PDF for a student in an unassigned class, **when** the request is made, **then** it is refused exactly as the on-screen report would be.
beforeCriteria.F13-AC12: **(US-057) Given** a generated PDF, **when** its download link is used after it expires, or by another user, **then** access is refused.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC1: **(US-058) Given** a valid `Students` workbook of 50 rows, **when** the Admin uploads it, previews it, and confirms, **then** 50 students are created in the active madrasa (AC-XLS-01).
beforeCriteria.F14-AC2: **(US-058) Given** a workbook with more than 1,000 rows, **when** it is uploaded, **then** it is rejected before any processing, with the message "Maximum 1,000 rows per file — split into several files".
beforeCriteria.F14-AC3: **(US-058) Given** a workbook with the wrong template version or a missing required column, **when** it is uploaded, **then** it is rejected with the expected version and the missing column named.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC4: **(US-058) Given** a workbook already imported with stable `ExternalStudentID`s, **when** it is imported again, **then** every row is an exact match, and no new student is created (AC-XLS-03).
beforeCriteria.F14-AC5: **(US-058) Given** a row whose name matches an existing student but has no `ExternalStudentID`, **when** it is previewed, **then** it is flagged as a suspected duplicate for review. It is never treated as the same student automatically.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC6: **(US-059) Given** a valid `DailyRecords` workbook, **when** it is imported, **then** each row becomes one portion, rows with the same student, date, and session form one daily record, and reports recalculate.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC7: **(US-059) Given** a row with `ExternalStudentID` not found in the active madrasa, **when** it is previewed, **then** it is invalid with the message "Student not found in this madrasa".
beforeCriteria.F14-AC8: **(US-059) Given** an `organization_id` or a different madrasa named in the workbook, **when** it is imported, **then** it is ignored, and every row goes into the signed-in user's madrasa only.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC9: **(US-059) Given** a row with `MistakeCount = 3`, **when** it is imported, **then** the attempt stores 3 uncategorized mistakes, and no mistake categories are created.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC10: **(US-059) Given** a row with an empty `QualityRating`, **when** it is imported, **then** the quality is stored as NULL, not 0.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC11: **(US-060) Given** an uploaded workbook, **when** the preview opens, **then** it shows counts of new, exact-match, suspected-duplicate, invalid, and proposed-update rows, with row- and field-level errors in the user's language.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC12: **(US-060) Given** invalid columns, malformed dates, invalid statuses, or duplicate keys, **when** the preview opens, **then** each problem appears as a message on its row and field (AC-XLS-02).
beforeCriteria.F14-AC13: **(US-060) Given** existing records that the workbook would change, **when** the import runs in the default add-new-only mode, **then** those records are not changed (AC-XLS-04).
beforeCriteria.F14-AC14: **(US-060) Given** the user selects update mode, **when** the preview opens, **then** each proposed update shows field-level before and after values, and nothing is written until the user confirms.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC15: **(US-060) Given** an import whose second batch fails, **when** it is retried, **then** the rows already committed are not duplicated, and the result lists exactly which rows succeeded and which failed.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC16: **(US-061) Given** a Teacher exporting records, **when** the file is generated, **then** it contains only their assigned students and the selected date range (AC-XLS-05).
beforeCriteria.F14-AC17: **(US-061) Given** an export for a Student or Parent audience, **when** the file is generated, **then** no internal notes appear (AC-XLS-06).
beforeCriteria.F14-AC18: **(US-061) Given** a student name that starts with `=`, `+`, `-`, or `@`, **when** it is exported, **then** the cell is escaped so the spreadsheet shows it as text and does not run it as a formula (AC-XLS-06).
beforeCriteria.F14-AC19: **(US-061) Given** any export, **when** it is opened, **then** IDs, dates, units, canonical statuses, and Arabic text are unchanged. Report exports include the period, timezone, filters, generation time, and a pending-offline-changes flag.
beforeCriteria.F14-AC20: **(US-058) Given** any import or export, **when** it finishes, **then** an audit event records the actor, madrasa, time, operation, and outcome counts, with no student details.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC1: **(US-062) Given** a student's records, **when** Analytics opens, **then** it shows Sabaq/Sabqi/Manzil progress, assigned vs completed quantities per unit, mistake trends by category and severity, quality trend, recurring difficult portions, and attendance context, all calculated from source records.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC2: **(US-062) Given** no internet connection, **when** Analytics opens, **then** the metrics are calculated from local data and labelled "Provisional", with the last sync time and the pending-change count (AC-AI-02).
beforeCriteria.F15-AC3: **(US-062) Given** quality scores in the trend, **when** the chart is drawn, **then** the axis runs from 1 · Excellent at the top to 5 · Weak at the bottom, missing ratings are gaps, and a falling average is described as improvement.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC4: **(US-063) Given** AI enabled and a Teacher online, **when** they tap "Get AI recommendations", **then** the response is shown in a separate area labelled "AI suggestion — review required", stating the date range and the metrics it used.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC5: **(US-063) Given** no internet connection, **when** the Teacher views Analytics, **then** the AI button shows "AI needs a connection", and no AI text is shown or invented (AC-AI-01).
beforeCriteria.F15-AC6: **(US-063) Given** the provider times out or errors, **when** the request fails, **then** the Teacher sees "AI unavailable — try again later", and daily entry, reports, and sync keep working (AC-AI-04).
beforeCriteria.F15-AC7: **(US-063) Given** an AI response, **when** it is received, **then** the server checks it against the response schema and confirms every number it cites exists in the metrics sent; a response that fails either check is discarded and shown as unavailable.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC8: **(US-063) Given** any AI response, **when** it is handled, **then** no daily record, attempt, quality score, or homework is created or changed (AC-AI-03).
beforeCriteria.F15-AC9: **(US-063) Given** a Student or Parent, **when** they use the app, **then** no AI feature is offered to them, and the API refuses AI requests from them.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC10: **(US-064) Given** a Madrasa Admin, **when** they choose a provider from the supported list, set it on or off, and set a request limit, **then** the settings are saved and audited.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC11: **(US-064) Given** AI turned off, **when** a Teacher opens Analytics, **then** the AI button is hidden, and the API refuses AI requests.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC12: **(US-064) Given** the madrasa has reached its usage limit, **when** a Teacher asks for a recommendation, **then** it is refused with "AI limit reached for this period", and no provider call is made.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC13: **(US-065) Given** the default privacy settings, **when** an AI request is built, **then** it contains no student name, contact details, or teacher notes. The student is referred to only by a pseudonym.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC14: **(US-065) Given** an Admin who turns off a data category (e.g. attendance), **when** the next request is built, **then** that category is not in the payload.
beforeCriteria.F15-AC15: **(US-065) Given** any AI request, **when** it is stored for usage tracking, **then** the stored record holds the minimized payload and an input hash, not raw student records.
beforeCriteria.F16-AC1: **(US-066) Given** a signed-in user on Android who allowed notifications, **when** the app starts, **then** their device token is registered for that account and madrasa.
beforeCriteria.F16-AC2: **(US-066) Given** a supported event for a user, **when** it happens, **then** one push is sent to that user's registered devices.
beforeCriteria.F16-AC3: **(US-066) Given** a push about a student, **when** its payload is built, **then** it contains a generic message and a deep link only, with no student name, scores, or note text.
beforeCriteria.F16-AC4: **(US-066) Given** a user who taps a push, **when** the app opens, **then** it goes to the linked screen after authentication, and the server applies normal permission checks.

beforeCriteria.F16-AC9: **(US-067) Given** the Notifications settings, **when** they open, **then** only Android push options are shown, with no email, SMS, or WhatsApp.
beforeCriteria.F16-AC10: **(US-067) Given** Android notification permission is denied, **when** the user opens Notifications settings, **then** they see "Notifications are off in Android settings", with a button that opens Android settings.

beforeCriteria.F17-AC2: **(US-068) Given** a repository query missing its organization filter (a deliberately broken test query), **when** it runs under the app's database role, **then** RLS returns no rows from other madaris.
beforeCriteria.F17-AC3: **(US-068) Given** a request that sends a different `organization_id` in the body, query, or header, **when** it is processed, **then** the madrasa comes from the signed-in membership only.
beforeCriteria.F17-AC4: **(US-068) Given** a removed member, **when** they make any request, **then** it is refused, and the audit records they created remain (AC-SEC-05).
beforeCriteria.F17-AC5: **(US-068) Given** production, **when** any API call is made over plain HTTP, **then** it is refused or redirected to HTTPS.
beforeCriteria.F17-AC6: **(US-069) Given** an Admin, **when** they open Audit history, **then** they see a paginated list for their madrasa only, with the actor, action, target, time, and summary, and filters by date, actor, and action.
beforeCriteria.F17-AC7: **(US-069) Given** a daily record, **when** an authorized user taps "View history", **then** they see that record's audited changes in time order.
beforeCriteria.F17-AC8: **(US-069) Given** a Teacher, Student, or Parent, **when** they try to open the madrasa audit history, **then** they are refused (whether Teachers may see their own actions is open).
beforeCriteria.F17-AC9: **(US-069) Given** an audit entry for a password reset, **when** it is displayed, **then** it shows that a reset happened, with no password, OTP, or token.

beforeCriteria.F17-AC11: **(US-070) Given** more reset requests for one account than the rate limit allows, **when** another is made, **then** no OTP is sent, and the event is audited as rate-limited.
beforeCriteria.F17-AC12: **(US-070) Given** a successful password reset, **when** it completes, **then** every session of that account is revoked, and the reset is audited with the time and the requesting device.
beforeCriteria.F17-AC13: **(US-070) Given** repeated failed OTP tries across many accounts from one IP, **when** the threshold is passed, **then** further tries from that IP are throttled.
